jobs.title: Smart Contract Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us:

ether.fi is an innovative, rapidly growing crypto-native financial platform on a mission to put users in control of their wealth - making it easy to save, earn, and spend crypto. Positioned as a leading decentralized finance (DeFi) bank, ether.fi offers a fully integrated, non-custodial suite of products - Stake, Liquid, and Cash - that bridge crypto utility with real-world convenience.

With over $8B in assets under management and a lean, agile team of 25+, we’re building sustainable, secure, and scalable financial infrastructure to onboard the next billion users to crypto. Our offerings include liquid staking, automated yield strategies, and crypto-native payment solutions like credit cards, enabling a comprehensive decentralized banking experience.

As we continue to scale, we’re actively hiring talented, mission-driven individuals who want to shape the future of finance from the ground up.

Learn more at ether.fi.

Position Overview:

As a talented Smart Contract Engineer with a deep understanding of Solidity and extensive experience in writing and deploying smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain you will be a key component of the ether.fi team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing secure, efficient, and innovative smart contracts. Experience with development tools like Foundry and Hardhat for smart contract testing and deployment is highly regarded.

This role is onsite at of one of our locations 4x per week. We have offices in Toronto, Denver, and the Cayman Islands.

What you will do:

  • Design, develop, and deploy smart contracts on the Ethereum/L2 blockchains, ensuring they are secure, efficient, and optimized for gas consumption.

  • Conduct thorough testing and auditing of smart contracts to ensure security and functionality, utilizing tools such as Forge for an enhanced development workflow.

  • Stay abreast of the latest developments in Ethereum, Solidity, and blockchain technology to continually improve contract efficiency and security.

  • Contribute to the development of internal best practices for smart contract development, including security measures, coding standards, and documentation.

  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers to maintain high-quality code standards.

  • Assist in the development and deployment of blockchain infrastructure

What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong foundation in cryptographic principles and blockchain technology. Advanced degrees are a plus.

  • Proficient in Solidity with a solid portfolio of deployed smart contracts and DApps.

  • Proficient in smart contract security practices and common vulnerabilities.

  • Proficient in Cryptography techniques such as zero-knowledge proofs, roll-ups, etc

  • Experience with Ethereum development tools such as Foundry and Hardhat

  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools for blockchain development is advantageous.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work both independently and within a collaborative team environment.

  • Strong communication skills to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to both technical and non-technical team members.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and token allocation grant

  • Opportunity to work with a Top 4 Ethereum protocol, by TVL

  • Opportunities for professional development and growth within the organization

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance plans

  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture

  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in the blockchain and cryptocurrency space

  • Global team with opportunity for travel and working out of our 3 offices around the world

  • 4 weeks work from anywhere

  • Exciting company events and team-building off-sites

jobs.title: KYC Analyst – Ether.fi Cash Program
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About

ether.fi is a leading non-custodial liquid staking protocol and DeFi ecosystem. With products like eETH, weETH, Liquid Vaults, and Ether.fi Cash, we’re building the rails that connect decentralized finance to everyday financial products. Our vision is to give users a secure, transparent, and seamless way to stake, earn, and spend in crypto.

The Role

We are seeking a KYC Analyst to join our compliance team and support the onboarding of retail users to the Ether.fi Cash program. You will be responsible for conducting KYC and customer due diligence checks, verifying applicant information, and ensuring onboarding is efficient, accurate, and fully compliant with regulatory requirements. You will work closely with the Compliance Manager to refine workflows, ensure adherence to global AML/CTF standards, and deliver a smooth experience for users.

Responsibilities

  • Review and process retail KYC applications for Ether.fi Cash customers, ensuring accurate collection and verification of identity documentation.

  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) where required, including PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening.

  • Assess risk profiles of applicants and escalate high-risk cases to the Compliance Manager for review.

  • Maintain accurate and complete records of all KYC activity to meet audit and regulatory standards.

  • Assist in refining and improving onboarding workflows to balance user experience with compliance requirements.

  • Monitor ongoing activity and support periodic reviews of existing customers where required.

  • Collaborate with product and operations teams to align compliance processes with business needs.

  • Support the Compliance Manager with reporting, regulatory filings, and ad-hoc compliance initiatives.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in KYC/AML, compliance, or retail onboarding at a fintech, payments, or crypto company.

  • Strong understanding of AML/CTF requirements, FATF standards, and KYC best practices for retail customers.

  • Familiarity with KYC/AML technology platforms, identity verification tools, and screening databases.

  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working with sensitive customer data.

  • A proactive problem-solver with the ability to adapt to a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Why Join Ether.fi

  • Play a central role in building the compliance infrastructure for one of the most innovative crypto + payments programs in the market.

  • Join a small, high-caliber team where you’ll have direct impact and ownership.

  • Competitive compensation with opportunities for growth as Ether.fi expands globally.

  • Be part of a mission-driven company at the forefront of DeFi, staking, and next-gen financial products.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

ether.fi is one of the largest crypto companies in the world, with over $10B in assets under management and a team of ~50, almost entirely technical staff. We’ve been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer financial applications.

We believe the future of finance is true on-chain banking. Our products, Stake, Liquid, and Cash, let users earn yield through DeFi strategies and spend their assets globally through our credit card program. You can view our growth publicly on Dune.

As we scale our financial products, maintaining world-class fraud/risk defense is core to protecting our users and the long-term health of our card program.

Position overview

We’re hiring a Fraud Lead with a natural scam hunter mindset. You enjoy spotting anomalous patterns, reverse-engineering attack campaigns and building systems that stay one step ahead of sophisticated fraudsters.

This is a high-ownership role where you will own the full fraud stack for ether.fi's campaigns, credit card program, fund flows while working extremely closely with our Engineering, CX and compliance teams.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role:

We're looking for a Security Engineer who is equally at home hardening a CI/CD pipeline, reviewing a change to the authentication system on the backend, and triaging a bug bounty submission before lunch.This is a hands-on, builder-first role - not a governance checkbox. You'll own security operations end-to-end, embedded directly into the engineering team and working closely with infrastructure, protocol and platform.

If you treat threat modeling as a design conversation and not a compliance exercise, you're our kind of person. You should only apply for this role if you are ready to come into the office every day and work in person with our team!

What You'll Do:

Security Operations

  • Own day-to-day security operations: monitoring, alerting, triage, and response

  • Manage and monitor endpoint security via an EDR system - tune detections, investigate alerts, and drive incidents to resolution

  • Lead identity lifecycle management, including employee onboarding and off boarding (access provisioning, key rotation, deprovisioning)

Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management

  • Be the primary owner of our ImmuneFi program - triaging, reproducing, and responding to incoming submissions daily

  • Prioritize and track vulnerabilities through to remediation in close collaboration with protocol and engineering teams

  • Develop internal tooling and processes to make the bounty workflow faster and more consistent

DevSecOps & Pipeline Hardening

  • Audit and harden CI/CD pipelines - secrets management, supply chain integrity, SAST/DAST integration, build provenance

  • Own dependency security: identify and remediate vulnerable packages across repositories (yes, including the npm dependency hell)

  • Establish and enforce security standards across the SDLC

Infrastructure Security

  • Partner with the infrastructure team to review and harden cloud environments (access controls, network segmentation, least privilege, logging)

  • Contribute to threat modeling for new systems and architectural changes

  • Drive implementation of security tooling across the stack

Vendor & External Partner Management

  • Own relationships with external security vendors and service providers — holding them accountable toSLAs, managing scope, and ensuring findings are actioned

  • Evaluate and onboard new security tooling as the team and threat landscape evolve

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in software and security engineering, with meaningful time in a DevSecOps or security operations context

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals - you're a builder who writes code, not just policy

  • Hands-on experience hardening CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or equivalent)

  • Proficiency with endpoint security tooling (CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR)

  • Comfort owning identity and access management processes, including onboarding/offboarding workflows

  • Strong communication skills - you can write a clear triage report, give direct feedback to a developer and explain risk to a non-technical stakeholder

Nice to Have:

  • You were a traditional software engineer before specializing in security

  • Prior experience at a DeFi protocol, crypto exchange, or blockchain infrastructure company

  • CTF/security competition background

  • Contributions to open-source security tooling

What Success Looks Like:

About the role

ether.fi spans decentralized ETH staking (weETH), the Liquid vault range, and Cash, a card and neobank product. This role owns the company's commercial and partnership agenda across the board: the payments stack behind Cash, ecosystem and chain deals, and the institutional relationships that drive distribution.   • Manage counterparty relationships with trading, lending, and treasury partners.

  • Negotiate incentive deals and rev-share agreements

  • Drive native deployments of ether.fi assets on new chains where they unlock distribution

  • Structure launch partnerships for new products

Expansion

  • Identify and negotiate partners for new markets and corridors (local ramps, regional payment networks, licensing partners) alongside the compliance and legal teams

  • 5+ years in partnerships, BD, or commercial roles spanning fintech/payments and crypto

The second pillar is fraud and risk. Today our defense is largely reactive; you will make it proactive on both sides of the line. Build the rules, monitoring, and internal tooling, and also use them: pull the data yourself, investigate the cases, work out what the attacker actually did, and turn that into the rule that catches it next time.

You'll work closely with Product, CX, and Compliance, and directly with our card program and fraud vendors.

What you'll do

  • Improve the card transaction experience: hunt down and eliminate the causes of declines, failed authorizations, stuck holds, and the frictions users actually hit when they spend

  • Make the card program better as a product; find where it breaks for real users, propose the fix, ship it

  • Hunt fraud and abuse patterns: card testing, cashback farming, merchant abuse, friendly fraud, trial and force-post abuse, multi-account rings

  • Own our fraud stack: rules, queues, and scoring logic in Sardine, plus real-time monitoring, alerting, and automated mitigation

  • Investigate live cases hands-on; query the transaction data, root-cause the pattern, and propose the rule or control that stops it recurring

  • Build internal tools, dashboards, and scripts that make our risk and CX teams dramatically more effective

What we are looking for

  • Strong fundamentals in software engineering and problem solving

  • 4+ years of professional coding experience, shipping products

jobs.title: Blockchain Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

ether.fi is a fast-growing crypto-native financial platform on a mission to put users in control of their wealth, making it easy to save, earn, and spend crypto. As a leading decentralized finance (DeFi) bank, ether.fi offers a fully integrated, non-custodial suite of products (Stake, Liquid, and Cash) that bridge crypto utility with real-world convenience.

Nonce is the team behind ether.fi's DeFi yield vaults, the products that take user deposits and put them to work across DeFi. A depositor gets a single position and a yield-bearing token. Behind it sits a mandate, a set of whitelisted protocols and strategies, live NAV accounting, and a redemption path that has to stay honest whether the market is calm or not. The whole job is deploying into lending markets, LSTs and LRTs, basis and funding trades, stablecoin strategies, and whatever comes next, safely, with the risk understood before the capital moves.

It's a small team with a lot of autonomy. Every vault, every rebalance, and every new protocol integration goes through this team.

Learn more at ether.fi.

Position overview

We're hiring a smart contract / backend engineer to help build and operate ether.fi's DeFi yield vaults. You'll write the contracts that allocate user capital, build the tooling/systems that runs 365/24/7 to safely monitor and manage the capital.

The immediate focus is the next generation of Nonce's vault product to power one of the largest DeFi yield vaults products in the industry. Getting that right, and keeping it secure, is the main thing this role is here to do.

This is a build-and-operate role. You'll ship Solidity and backend services, and you'll also share the day-to-day of running live vaults: discussing new yield opportunities, reviewing transactions, signing them, and deciding whether a new protocol is safe to allocate into. The team is small, so the people who write the vaults are the people who run them.

This role is onsite 4 days per week at one of our global offices: NYC, Denver, or the Cayman Islands.

What you'll work on

Vaults

  • Design, write, deploy, and configure yield vault smart contracts alongside the rest of the vault team

  • Build vault tooling: putting on trades, rebalancing across strategies, updating vault policies and whitelists, admin configuration

  • Extend the vault architecture as new yield strategies, assets, and chains come online

  • Review teammates' contracts and tooling, and get reviewed in turn

  • Prove the contracts do what they claim: unit and fuzz tests, invariants, and formal verification where it earns its keep

  • Work with external auditors through review cycles, and write contracts that are straightforward to audit in the first place

Backend services

  • Build and maintain the critical systems that run 365/24/7 without failure: the solver powering redemption flows, including the liquidity buffer, report NAV changes, security concerns and unwind logic behind them

  • Build and maintain the NAV service, pricing every position a vault holds, and the accuracy guarantees behind the share price

  • Automate on-chain operations so allocation, harvesting, and rebalancing run reliably without a human in the loop

Risk and protocol operations

  • Own the new-protocol review pipeline: given a new protocol, read the docs and contracts, assess the risk, and decide whether and on what terms we allocate

  • Review and sign vault rebalancing transactions as a multisig signer

  • Build monitoring and automation that catches a broken oracle, a depeg, a stuck withdrawal, or a bad allocation before users do

  • Participate as a security guardian across ether.fi's web3 stack and operations

You might be a fit if you

  • Write strong production Solidity: clean, secure, and designed around edge cases and failure modes

  • Are equally strong on the backend: services, automation, and tooling that hold up when they're running against real money

  • Know DeFi deeply enough to read a protocol's docs and contracts, understand where the yield actually comes from, and form your own view on where it breaks

  • Have 4+ years of industry engineering experience

  • Have shipped a real yield vault (ERC-4626, BoringVault-style, or your own architecture) and operated it after launch

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments where the best idea wins

Bonus

  • Experience at a vault platform, asset curator, or yield product with real TVL, either building the vaults or curating what goes into them

  • Hands-on with the strategies themselves: lending markets, LSTs and LRTs, basis and funding trades, stablecoin yield

  • Audit or security review background

  • You've hacked on this for fun: your own contracts, protocol audits, MEV bots, or just a lot of hours across DeFi protocols

jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ether.fi

ether.fi is one of the largest DeFi protocols on Ethereum. We started with weETH, a liquid staking token that now secures billions of dollars of staked ETH, and built outward from there: the Liquid vault range, which runs automated yield strategies across ETH, stablecoins and BTC, and ether.fi Cash, a Visa card and neobank product that lets users spend directly against their on-chain balances.

Behind the protocol is a group of operating companies in Cayman, Brazil, the US, Canada and the UAE, including a regulated investment manager and a licensed VASP. We are continuing to open new markets and add additional regulated products, with finance playing a key role in this expansion.

The role

We're hiring a Head of Finance to run the finance function. Today finance sits with the COO/CFO and financial controller. We are looking for someone to own the following: month end, audits, budget, tax, treasury operations, fund NAV, payments and payroll. The CFO will set policy and sign off. You own everything else.

It's a small team. You'll have one accountant reporting to you and can hire as we grow, but you need to be comfortable doing the work yourself. We're based across several time zones and you'll be working with legal, compliance, ops and the product teams every week.

What you'll do

  • Run month end across all entities. Management accounts within 15 business days, quarterly reporting within 45 days.

  • Balance sheet recs, including wallets, exchange and custody balances against the ledger.

  • Revenue recognition for protocol fees, vault fees, card interchange and treasury income.

  • Lead our statutory audits.

  • Own the annual budget and monthly budget vs actuals. Every material assumption needs to be documented and something you can defend.

  • Cash forecasting.

  • Daily liquidity monitoring across fiat, stables and crypto. Weekly portfolio review and rebalancing to targets set by the CFO. Moving funds for payroll and payments.

  • Put intercompany agreements and a transfer pricing model in place with our advisers.

  • Tax and regulatory finance filings across Cayman, Brazil, US, Canada and UAE (economic substance, US information returns, CRA).

  • Weekly payment run, vendors, payroll and contractors in several countries, token vesting and payouts, expenses.

  • Card inventory and cost tracking with Ops.

  • Own the finance systems (QuickBooks, crypto sub-ledger, AP tool, payroll, cap table) and cut down the manual recs.

  • Work with Compliance, Ecosystem and Product on fee models and new launches. Help HR with comp budgets, relocations and payroll.

What we're looking for

  • Qualified accountant (CA, CPA, ACCA). Big 4 audit background preferred.

  • 8+ years post-qualification, at least 4 of them in-house at a crypto, fintech or asset management business.

  • Has run a finance function before, as controller or head of finance, across multiple entities and currencies.

  • Has owned audits end to end.

  • Hands-on with intercompany agreements and transfer pricing.

  • Comfortable with crypto: wallet recs, token accounting, staking rewards, NAV for crypto funds.

  • Organised and direct. Flags problems early rather than at month end.

  • Able to work in Cayman (right to work or eligible for a permit). Relocation support is available.

Nice to have

  • Cayman funds: CIMA registration, investment manager entities, working with administrators.

  • VASP, payments or card program experience, including interchange.

  • US and Canadian tax.

  • Multi-country payroll and token compensation.

  • QuickBooks Online, a crypto sub-ledger, AP automation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

ether.fi is one of the largest crypto companies in the world. We have over $10B in assets under management and a team of around 50. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer applications.

The future we envisage is true on-chain banking. Our current products, Stake, Liquid and Cash, let users earn yield across a range of DeFi strategies and spend their assets in the real world with our cards. You can view public analytics on Dune for Cash and Stake.

Position overview

We're looking for a KOL and Social Manager to find, sign and manage KOLs (key opinion leaders: creators and influencers) who bring real users to ether.fi, and to run our day-to-day social posting. This is a user acquisition role: a KOL partnership is worth keeping only if it refers quality users.

What you'll do

  • Research and scrape to find KOLs whose audiences match our users

  • Build your own tools to speed up sourcing and tracking, using AI-assisted coding (vibe coding)

  • Recruit KOLs, set them up with referral tracking and manage the relationships

  • Track referred users per KOL and cut partnerships that don't perform

  • Spend about an hour a day posting across ether.fi's social channels

Your first 90 days

  • Build a roster of 10-20 KOLs, each referring more than 50 quality users a month

What we are looking for

  • You can vibe code: you build simple tools and scripts with AI to get work done faster

  • Strong research skills, including scraping to build lists and find people

  • Comfortable posting and running social accounts daily

  • Prior KOL experience is not required

  • Drive, willingness to work hard and go the extra mile. We are a highly ambitious, driven team with audacious goals, and we work very hard to make them a reality

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ether.fi

ether.fi is a DeFi neo-bank. People use the ether.fi app to save, spend and borrow with crypto, including through the ether.fi card. We have offices in Grand Cayman, New York, Denver and Dubai, and the team is growing quickly.

About the role

We are hiring an HR Generalist to run HR operations at ether.fi across our four offices, from employment compliance and employee records to payroll, benefits, onboarding and employee engagement.

Our people function is being built now, so you will help shape the policies and processes the company runs on as it scales. You will work closely with Operations, Recruitment, Finance and Legal.

What you’ll do:

Compliance and employment

  • Keep ether.fi compliant with employment law in the Cayman Islands, New York, Colorado and the UAE, working with Legal and external advisers.

  • Prepare and maintain employment contracts and templates for each location, in partnership with Legal and Recruitment.

  • Manage our Employer of Record partner for UAE hires, including visas and moves to Dubai.

  • Keep employee records accurate and give managers and leadership clear reporting on headcount and time away.

Candidate relocation

  • Take over from Recruitment once a candidate accepts, and guide them from offer to first day.

  • Manage work permits and visas, including Cayman work permits and UAE visas through our EOR, and track every document and deadline.

  • Coordinate flights, temporary housing and relocation allowances within the agreed budget, and keep candidates informed at each step.

Onboarding and processes

  • Run onboarding for every new hire and use what we learn to improve it.

  • Document core HR processes as clear, repeatable SOPs so the team works consistently as we grow.

Payroll and benefits

  • Partner with Finance to run US payroll and the 401(k) program, and answer benefits questions for employees in every office.

  • Keep benefits documentation current and look for ways to improve what we offer across all offices.

Engagement and development

  • Run our pulse survey, analyze the results and turn them into actions agreed with leadership.

  • Plan our company off-sites.

Offboarding

  • Run offboarding and exit interviews, and turn what we hear into changes.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years in HR or People Operations, including at least 1 year as the main HR operator at a startup or scale-up.

  • Experience with employment law, contracts and benefits in more than one country.

  • Working knowledge of US employment requirements, including payroll, benefits administration and state-level rules.

  • Experience owning an HRIS and building your own reports.

  • Clear writing and the ability to turn a messy process into a simple SOP.

  • Good judgment with confidential and sensitive situations.

  • Comfort working across time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another regulated financial business.

  • Experience managing an EOR relationship or sponsoring work visas.

  • Familiarity with Gusto, Betterment, Remote.com or Shapes.

  • A recognized HR qualification such as CIPD or SHRM.
